players.product: 800G/1.6T optical transceivers + high-power ELSFP lasers (US-anchored manufacturing)

quarterly_data.signal: AAOI's 10-K: Data Center revenue was $195.7M in fiscal year 2025 (+31.8% YoY vs $148.5M). In 2025 the CATV, internet data center, telecom and FTTH/other markets provided 53.8%, 42.9%, 3.0% and 0.3% of revenue, versus 35.2%, 59.5%, 4.4% and 0.9% in 2024. Its key CATV customer Digicomm accounted for 53.1% of 2025 revenue, and five customers accounted for 95% of 2025 revenue (XBRL).
quarterly_data.figure: Data Center $195.7M (+31.8% YoY), fiscal year 2025; data center 42.9% of 2025 revenue vs 59.5% in 2024; Digicomm 53.1%; five customers 95%

connects_to.relationship: fiber optic networking products for the internet data center market (Microsoft = key data center customer)

contracts.signal: AAOI's 10-K names Microsoft as its key customer in the internet data center market in 2025; Microsoft accounted for 28.8% of AAOI's revenue in 2025. The XBRL concentration facts put Microsoft at 29% of revenue for 2025 and 44% for 2024.
AAOI's 10-K states that Oracle accounted for 12.4% of AAOI's revenue in 2024.
